name: Handbook
thesis: The site reads like the printed Scout handbook: table of contents, chapter openers, hanging numbers, marginalia and plates.
look: Tan paper and olive-black ink, handbook red as the one accent, gold only for Eagle marks. Fraunces + Source Serif 4 + Public Sans small caps.

axes.nav: Running-head header; sticky left margin column with chapter contents (collapsible on mobile)
axes.modes: Labelled rules across the block: “Do one of the following”
axes.reqs: Numbered document with hanging numbers and letters, small-caps eyebrow for curated titles, “See also” references
axes.guide: Book page: boxed requirement epigraph, drop cap, margin notes at wide widths, plates with captions
axes.search: Concordance: italic headword, entries grouped by award, red paths, no cards

home: Title page with an Index box, then a Contents list with dotted leaders (MBU: 14 fields; SU: two Parts, seven ranks)
award: Chapter opener spread: plate or level numeral, “In this chapter”, chapter facts, references

name: Trailhead
thesis: Every page answers “where am I, where next, how far”: wayfinding borrowed from topographic maps, trailhead kiosks and blaze markers.
look: Olive and tan ground, blaze orange accent, CSS contour-line texture. Condensed grotesque labels with a sturdy body sans.

axes.nav: Persistent left trail-legend rail (bottom sheet on mobile); slim kiosk header
axes.modes: Trail-junction signposts: DO ALL ↓ / CHOOSE 1 OF 3 →, children as forks
axes.reqs: One continuous vertical trail with blaze markers; children as side spurs; “you are here” highlight
axes.guide: Mile-marker gutter of guide groups; sticky requirement box; callouts as trail signs
axes.search: Legend-style filter rail; results as map pins per award with waypoint hits

home: MBU: a trail map hero with categories as trailheads and the marked Trail to Eagle. SU: the seven ranks as a winding blazed path
award: Trailhead kiosk: big sign, distance board, route preview strip, pamphlet rack

name: Ledger
thesis: A fast, dense reference tool for counselors and leaders: a docs site, not a brochure. Density, scannability, keyboard-first search.
look: Olive-tinted greys, one green accent, 1px rules, tight radii, tabular numerals. One neutral sans for everything.

axes.nav: Three-column docs layout: outline tree · content · on-this-page; 48px toolbar with always-present search
axes.modes: Compact label row under the stem plus a right-margin counter
axes.reqs: Table-like outline: path column, content column, indented children, filter toolbar
axes.guide: Docs page with bordered Requirement block and right-rail TOC generated from headings
axes.search: Flat ranked rows with a left facet rail; first row selected

home: No hero photo: big search, then a dense directory (MBU: category list + Eagle table; SU: seven-rank table + link lists)
award: Spec sheet: title row with pills, key-value facts grid, collapsed outline, plain link list

name: Night Watch
thesis: The campfire at night. Dark-first and cinematic: emblems glow like lanterns on layered forest greens with amber light.
look: Near-black greens, lantern amber, pale moss; soft glows and translucent borders. Light theme is “dawn”. Elegant serif display with a soft humanist sans.

axes.nav: Floating glass header that shrinks on scroll; right-hand floating rail; mobile bottom tab bar
axes.modes: Glowing amber eyebrow in the card header; children as a lit vertical rail
axes.reqs: Cards in a spotlight: the hovered or focused card lifts and lights while siblings dim
axes.guide: Reading mode: 65ch measure, amber-ruled requirement, full-bleed vignetted images, progress line
axes.search: Award panels with emblem lanterns in circular frames; amber underline-glow highlights

home: MBU: full-bleed night hero with glowing search, Eagle badges as a constellation grid. SU: seven ranks as rising stars along an ascending line
award: Floating glowing emblem or lit level numeral, glass facts card, lit requirement rail

name: Expedition
thesis: The page is a journey you scroll through: pinned stacking scenes, a progress rail that fills, elements entering on their own view timelines, view transitions between pages. Native CSS only.
look: Slate-green, canvas, ember red-orange, chalk white; big photographic moments. Variable display face with axes animated on scroll.

axes.nav: No sidebar; slim header that becomes a sticky expedition HUD with progress after the hero
axes.modes: “Leg 3 · Choose 1 of 3 routes” eyebrow; children as route options
axes.reqs: Scenes: each requirement a full-width scene with a sticky number panel; right-edge scroll-driven progress rail
axes.guide: Immersive article: pinned hero image, reading progress, parallax images, callouts entering on view()
axes.search: Staggered reveal of award panels on their own view() timelines

home: MBU: scroll story in four pinned scenes with a scroll-snap badge rail. SU: seven pinned rank scenes climbing to the summit
award: Cinematic hero that compresses into the HUD; the route as a horizontal scroll-snap rail of stops

name: Atlas
thesis: A spatial reference instrument: a radial atlas of badges, a requirement wheel, a ⌘K command palette on every page, popovers anchored to the thing they describe.
look: Graphite and bone instrument surfaces, deep green primary, brass gold ticks, hairline rules on a 4px grid. Geometric sans with tabular numerals.

axes.nav: Command-palette-first instrument bar; sticky top dial strip replaces any sidebar
axes.modes: Ring segments: a select mode draws an N-segment ring with “choose 1” in the centre
axes.reqs: Split instrument: tracklist on the left, full verbatim detail pane on the right; guide links as anchored popovers
axes.guide: Split view: requirement pinned in a sticky instrument card, prose scrolls; lightbox dialog images; radial chapter dial
axes.search: The command palette expanded: facet chips and a two-pane finder (awards · hits)

home: MBU: inline-SVG radial map of 14 categories with Eagle badges orbiting. SU: seven-segment rank dial climbing to Eagle
award: Requirement wheel (SVG spokes) with popover verbatim text; instrument readouts for facts
